'''Sluis Van''' was an astronomical object in the southern region of [[the galaxy]]'s<ref name="Tarkin" /> [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[Western Reaches]],<ref name="Location" /> along the [[Rimma Trade Route]], in square M-19 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It provided [[Starship|ships]] to [[Seswenna]]'s [[Outland Regions Security Force]] prior to the [[Clone Wars]]. 

==History==
In [[229 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'' dates itself to a [[Standard year|year]] after the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[230 BBY]].</ref>, Sluis Van was engulfed by the expanded [[Stormwall]] and lost contact with the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Eye">''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]''</ref>

[[Count]] [[Dooku]] later turned both Sluis Van and [[Yag'Dhul]] over to the side of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Tarkin" />

During the Clone Wars, Sluis Van was represented in the [[Separatist Senate]] by [[Aguth Omak]]. When Omak [[Death|died]], the [[Pau'an]] [[Tychon Nulvolio]] took over his seat.<ref name="Mask of Fear">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref>

In the first [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Sluis Van was one of the former Separatist Worlds to be integrated into the Galactic Empire on [[Separatist Reintegration Day]].<ref name="Mask of Fear" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sluis Van was first [[canon]]ically mentioned in the [[2014]] novel [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Tarkin" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the first book in [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']].<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Zahn [[Tuckerization|named it]] after his friend Don Vandersluis.<ref name="HTTE 20th">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>
